summary: Codere Online Luxembourg, S.A. furnished a Form 6-K containing a press release and investor presentation of unaudited Q3 2026 results (quarter ended September 30, 2026). Revenue was EUR 62.6mm (+31%), Gaming Win EUR 67.1mm (+30%), and Adjusted EBITDA EUR 4.2mm (+45%); Spain revenue rose 13% and Mexico 37%. Cash totaled EUR 65.6mm with no financial debt, and management reiterated FY2026 guidance of EUR 255-265mm Gaming Win and EUR 20-25mm Adjusted EBITDA. This is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special situation; no transaction terms, board recommendation, or advisor appear. Watch operating momentum and guidance delivery.
